source_file: pasted-text.txt (BUI milling KYP sheet extract, rows starting [154])
conversion_rules: inches/foot dimensions converted to mm (x25.4 / x0.3048); fractions 1/4,1/2,3/4 decoded
bucket weights interpreted as grams and recorded as weight_per_unit_kg
discount text "LESS n%" parsed to discount_percent: n
unit strings: PCS/per pc -> pcs; PER MTR/per mtr/meter -> meter; per-mm pricing is NOT a schema unit and is flagged
dates normalized to YYYY-MM-DD; numeric D/M-vs-M/D ambiguity flagged and M/D assumed
delivery "ready"/"reday" -> 0 days; ranges -> lower bound (flagged); "1 week" -> 7 days
empty MOQ -> schema default 1 (flagged); empty vendor_type/date_added/delivery_time_days reported as missing_required
belt joint_type not stated -> open_end assumed (flagged); food RUBBER -> belt_subtype white_rubber (flagged); PLASTIC bucket -> material pp (flagged)
source info not representable in schema (covers, cleats, applications, food-grade note, dual sizes) captured per record in validation_report.dropped_source_info
